subject: math

hotspots.label: Factors
hotspots.description: The factors are the two numbers multiplied — 3 rows and 4 dots per row.
hotspots.positionHint: The row-count label (3) along the left edge and the column-count label (4) along the top of the array.
hotspots.function: The numbers multiplied together in a multiplication problem.

hotspots.label: Array
hotspots.description: An array shows multiplication as a grid of rows and columns — 3 rows × 4 columns of dots.
hotspots.positionHint: The rectangular grid of 12 dots in the center of the mat.
hotspots.function: The visual grid that models factor × factor = product.

hotspots.label: Product
hotspots.description: The product is the total number of dots — 12 — no matter whether you read it as 3 × 4 or 4 × 3.
hotspots.positionHint: The flat label plate below the array showing the product 12.
hotspots.function: The result of multiplying the factors.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean rectangular dot array (3 rows × 4 columns) sits on a calm mat with small row/column count labels and a product plate below. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Array dots: small warm off-white spheres (roughness ~0.45) with subtle violet undercast so rows read. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). Labels: flat warm paper plates with ink text. Row/column count stubs: ink-grey. Product plate: warm amber with ink text (roughness ~0.5). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: multiplication as a 3×4 dot array with group-stepping and a flip that shows commutativity.

GEOMETRY: Mat (thin rounded slab ~3.6 wide). Array: 12 unit spheres arranged in 3 rows × 4 columns, centered near x≈0, z≈0, y≈0.25, dot spacing ~0.3. Row label (3) on the left edge; column label (4) on the top. Product plate with '12' beneath the mat (y ≈ −0.2). A Grouping layer lights one row at a time (4, then 8, then 12) to show repeated addition. A Rotate action spins the whole array 90° around the y-axis so it becomes 4 rows × 3 columns — same 12 dots.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) dot array / group lighting; (2) row/column labels; (3) product plate.

CAMERA: head-on from +z with slight downward tilt shows rows, labels, and product plate; calm, minimal chrome. Budget 5-10k triangles. Named nodes: Mat, Dots (12), RowLabel, ColumnLabel, ProductPlate, GroupLayerLights, RotatedGroup. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
